# Support

## Getting Help

If you need help with MyCryptoSignal.com, here are your options:

### Documentation
- **README**: [README.md](../README.md) - Project overview and quick start
- **API Documentation**: [docs/API_DOCUMENTATION.md](../mycryptosignal-public/mycryptosignal.com/docs/API_DOCUMENTATION.md)
- **Contributing Guide**: [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- **Security Policy**: [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)

### Community Support
- **GitHub Discussions**: [Ask questions and share ideas](https://github.com/axiopistisholdings/mycryptosignal.com/discussions)
- **GitHub Issues**: [Report bugs or request features](https://github.com/axiopistisholdings/mycryptosignal.com/issues)

### Commercial Support
For enterprise support, custom features, or consulting:
- **Email**: support@mycryptosignal.com
- **Website**: https://mycryptosignal.com/contact

### API Access
To request API access:
- Visit: https://mycryptosignal.com/get-access
- Email: api@mycryptosignal.com

### Security Issues
For security vulnerabilities, please follow our [Security Policy](../SECURITY.md):
- **Email**: security@mycryptosignal.com
- **DO NOT** open public issues for security vulnerabilities

## Response Times

- **Community Support** (GitHub): Best effort, typically within 48-72 hours
- **Commercial Support**: Within 24 hours (business days)
- **Security Issues**: Within 48 hours

## Before Asking for Help

1. Check existing documentation and README
2. Search closed issues for similar problems
3. Ensure you're using the latest version
4. Provide detailed information about your environment
5. Include relevant code snippets or error messages

Thank you for using MyCryptoSignal.com!
